name: click-powerup
title: ClickPowerUp
description: A bracketed button that arms on hover and powers up with an accent flash and bracket burst on every click.

name: sticky
title: StickyButton
description: A magnetic button whose body and label are pulled toward the cursor from a wide field, with parallax depth and tilt.

name: shiny-button
title: ShinyButton
description: A glossy, gradient-styled button with a layered inner glow and a glint that sweeps across on every click.

name: movie-pass
title: MoviePassButton
description: A cinema ticket button that tears along its perforation on click, hinging open or snapping apart.

name: minimal
title: MinimalButton
description: A quiet dark button with a hairline ring, inner highlight, soft drop shadow, and a chevron that nudges on hover.

name: dither-button
title: DitherButton
description: A button with an animated 4x4 ordered-dither wave background and a knockout label.

name: evil-eye-button
title: EvilEyeButton
description: A button with a React Bits evil eye shader background and a fiery readable label.

name: troll-button
title: TrollButton
description: A button that dodges the cursor until it runs out of stamina, then gives up and lets you click it.

name: chrome-button
title: ChromeButton
description: A button with an animated liquid chrome background.

name: brutal-button
title: BrutalButton
description: A NeoBrutalism style button with sharp shadows and stark borders.

name: aqua-button
title: AquaButton
description: A glossy pill button inspired by Apple's Aqua interface, with layered highlights and a soft inner glow.

name: 3d-button
title: ThreeDButton
description: A minimal 3D button with a clean deck-style press and sliding click sheen.

name: frame-button
title: FrameButton
description: A futuristic button with springy corner markers that spread on hover and lock on when pressed, plus a scan sweep.

name: highlight-button
title: HighlightButton
description: A button with a cursor spotlight, a border that lights up near the pointer, and a ripple from wherever you click.

name: glitch-button
title: GlitchButton
description: A button with randomized RGB-split glitch bursts, a scanline overlay, and a flickering label.

name: command-button
title: CommandButton
description: A button with a global keyboard shortcut, shown as keycaps that sink as you hold each key.

name: copy-button
title: CopyButton
description: A copy button that briefly shows the copied text above itself, so you see exactly what landed on the clipboard.

name: reveal-button
title: RevealButton
description: A button that reveals a hidden secret value on hold or toggle, with a blur-in animation and an eye icon indicator.

name: demonic-button
title: DemonicButton
description: A hold-to-summon button: keep pressing to raise ridged devil horns from behind it while a canvas fire builds into a roar.

name: hold-button
title: HoldButton
description: A hold-to-confirm button whose inner fill grows from 0 to 100%; release early to shake and abort, hold to the end to fire the action.

name: doubt-button
title: DoubtButton
description: An escalating-confirmation button that makes you click through increasingly absurd, guilt-tripping prompts before the real action finally fires.

name: slide-to-detonate
title: SlideToDetonate
description: A slide-to-confirm safety gate that makes you drag a handle across a fuse before the real action detonates.

name: morph-status-button
title: MorphStatusButton
description: A single button that morphs through idle, loading, success, and error states in place, with no layout shift.

name: cooldown-button
title: CooldownButton
description: A button that locks itself behind a draining radial timer after each click to stop spam and double-submits, taunting you while you wait.

name: pill-button
title: PillButton
description: A compact pill toggle that slides between two labeled faces with a rolling hover label animation.

name: confetti-button
title: ConfettiButton
description: A ringed dark button with a sparkle icon that fires a restrained confetti burst on click.

name: ash-burst-button
title: AshBurstButton
description: A ringed dark button that glows like an ember on click and erupts ash that collides with it via Matter.js physics, piling onto its surface.
